text.p: Property investment firm Benchmark Group Plc said it has been granted options to acquire 10 properties in London from London Capital Holdings Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Friends' Provident Life Office for 113.9 million stg.

Benchmark will pay for the deal via the issue of 41.4 million new shares to Friends Provident plus 47.6 million stg cash. It will also raise 25.9 million stg net via a placing an open offer of 17.2 million new ordinary shares at 160 pence each.

The properties are six freehold and four long leasehold buildings, with net annual rental income of 8.9 million stg. They have been independently valued at 120.5 million stg, which equates to an initial yield of 7.4 percent.
Benchmark also published its results for the year to end June 1996. It reported pretax profit of 61,000 stg against a loss of 226,000 stg last time. There was no dividend.
Benchmark is controlled by Hong Leong Company (Malaysia) Berhad.
